notes.title: New Cinematic Trailer Reveals Bloodshore Release Date
notes.notes:
Today we can reveal that Bloodshore is set to wash up on all platforms starting [b]November 3[/b]. To celebrate the announcement, we've released a brand new trailer, check it out below!

Players must battle out in a dystopian battle royale set on a mysterious island location; where influencers, death row inmates and failing celebrities compete for a life-changing cash prize and all the attention they could ever want. Bloodshore will arrive on November 3 for PC, PS4, PS5 (bc), Xbox One, Xbox Series S/X (bc), Nintendo Switch, Mac, and iOS.

[previewyoutube=pCtjHdd_Evg;full][/previewyoutube]

What do you think?! We want to hear your thoughts in the comments below!

Want to find out more about each character? We'll be posting a new character bio every day on our [url=https://twitter.com/WalesInter]Twitter page[/url] (or you can wait for our next Steam blog post)

Wishlist the game to stay up-to-date with the news!
